headline: Iran Threatens Hormuz Blockade; IDF Strikes Hezbollah, Saudi Hit Today
subheadline: Iran's parliament debates restricting US and Israeli vessels in Strait of Hormuz while IDF hits Hezbollah targets after Lebanon explosion.
lede: Iran's parliament considers a bill to restrict vessel passage in the Strait of Hormuz targeting US and Israeli vessels, while explosions hit Qeshm Island and southern Lebanon kills two reservists. IDF strikes Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon after an explosion; a missile attack on Nujran, Saudi Arabia injures 11, and US Marine Corps aircraft redirect 49 commercial vessels in a blockade against Iran. In Ukraine, Russian tactical aviation bombs Sumy and Kharkiv regions with air bombs and drones, damaging infrastructure; Ukraine targets logistics facilities in Zaporizhye; Norway pledges air defense support amid US-Russia tensions over Patriot missile delays.

sections.title: Russian Aviation Pounds Sumy, Kharkiv; Ukraine Hits Logistics
sections.body: Russian tactical aviation launched air bombs on Sumy region and struck Kharkiv region with air bombs and drones, damaging infrastructure. Ukrainian military targeted logistics facilities in Zaporizhye. Norwegian Prime Minister pledged support for Ukrainian air defense systems. US-Russia tensions persist over Patriot missile supply delays.

sections.title: Iran Eyes Hormuz Control; Explosions Strike Lebanon, Iran
sections.body: Explosions reported on Qeshm Island, Iran, while an explosion in Majdal Zoun, southern Lebanon killed two reservist soldiers and injured four. Iran's parliament is considering a bill to restrict vessel passage in the Strait of Hormuz targeting US and Israeli vessels. IDF conducted strikes on Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon following an explosion. A missile attack on Nujran, Saudi Arabia injured 11, and US Marine Corps aircraft redirected 49 commercial vessels in a blockade against Iran.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran's proposed Hormuz blockade bill signals potential maritime escalation against US and Israeli interests, coinciding with US naval enforcement redirecting dozens of vessels. Simultaneous explosions in Iran and Lebanon alongside IDF-Hezbollah exchanges indicate widening cross-border hostilities, while Saudi Arabia suffers missile strikes. In Ukraine, Russia's sustained air bomb and drone campaign against northern infrastructure parallels Ukrainian strikes on rear logistics, with Western air defense commitments struggling to match tempo.
